zero_amplitude_policy: set entrainment, signed power, and uncertainty exactly to zero without pretending that a zero-motion history identifies phase

minimum_accepted_history.force_history_units: total force in N over declared section span

pairing.high_fidelity: prescribed-motion NACA0018 CFD or synchronized experiment
pairing.exact_runtime_base: native QBlade prescribed-motion force at the identical axis point and motion history

high_fidelity_initialization.solver: official Nalu-Wind v2.2.1 release at git commit ffa9de729df2a11b5241fdeb7628e7fab9f48f9b
high_fidelity_initialization.mesh: the original periodic NACA0018 span-4m IDDES mesh with exact file identity bound at campaign generation
high_fidelity_initialization.mesh_transformation: apply the one-time [0.23,0.23,1.0] x/y/z scaling only in the precursor initialized from the original chord-1m mesh; motion cases restart from the already-scaled precursor mesh without applying the scaling again
high_fidelity_initialization.precursor_policy: one stationary developed-wake precursor per Reynolds number using the same all-block mesh_motion schema with zero oscillation amplitude, branched to all k and A/c cases at that Reynolds number
high_fidelity_initialization.precursor_restart_time_policy: the selected precursor restart timestamp must equal 20*pi*c/U on an exact precursor step endpoint computed from the same unrounded U and c used by every child case
high_fidelity_initialization.motion: native all-block ALE oscillation with start_time equal to the precursor restart time
high_fidelity_initialization.phase_policy: the precursor time is 20*pi*c/U, making f*t0=20*k exactly 9,13,16,21 cycles for the frozen k grid; displacement starts at zero and velocity at positive maximum
high_fidelity_initialization.wall_policy: Nalu copies mesh_velocity to the no-slip wall when mesh motion is active
high_fidelity_initialization.force_surface: the full [wing,wing-pp] surface over the original 4m periodic span; wing-pp alone is forbidden
high_fidelity_initialization.force_sign: positive fluid-on-body force in the positive prescribed-motion direction
high_fidelity_initialization.runtime_base_geometry: native QBlade uses the same 0.23m chord, 4m span, incidence, fluid properties, and total-force normalization
high_fidelity_initialization.runtime_base_force_channel: total native aerodynamic force in global crossflow Y over the complete 4m section

file_identity.path: canonical path relative to the manifest directory
file_identity.sha256: SHA-256 of the exact bytes parsed

frozen_nonleakage_policy.minimum_map_condition_for_free_response: positive lower-confidence work exists and highest-amplitude plane is nonpositive

flight_parallel_plan.scope_boundary: this_minus_90_degree_slice can qualify Ehrmann only; H-VAWT requires a separately frozen incidence/Re extension after Ehrmann passes
